notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org (in-app chat + knowledge search) evaluating Redwood Hosted with plan to move to Dedicated. Current provider: incumbent LLM API (billing with OpenAI-like endpoint). Primary goals: reduce inference cost by ~30%, improve p95 latency for interactive chat, enable VPC/residency and stronger audit logs for compliance.

POC highlights: ran 2-week Hosted POC (Feb 12–26). Used Redwood compatibility layer to map existing OpenAI calls -> Redwood. Basic parity achieved for single-turn chat; discovered regressions in stop-sequence handling and structured function outputs. Tokenization differences causing small scoring deltas (esp. reranking tests).

Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 demo: "We need prompt parity — if answers shift unpredictably our product UX breaks. We like the cost numbers but care about regressions more."

Security/compliance notes: They require SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for key control, and US-only data residency for PII indexing. Legal requested a template data residency clause (drive link above).

Operational asks: 1) automated regression/eval harness that runs prompt sets and flags model-output drift, 2) compatibility shim for OpenAI-style client calls (done in POC but needs hardening), 3) canary rollout path for Dedicated with fallback to Hosted.

Pricing & economics: incumbent spend ~ $20k/month for prod inference; finance wants 25–35% reduction. Redwood pricing deck reviewed; AE provided committed-throughput vs burst options. Need final Dedicated sizing (gpus, reserved pool) to produce contract.

Next steps (short): run full regression suite on Hosted POC, verify fixes for stop-sequence & tokenization edge-cases, engineering review for VPC network layout, draft SOW for Dedicated sizing and pilot window.
